# Todo Tracker

> An ADHD-friendly task app that always shows the one thing to do now. Tasks are markdown files in a folder you own
> (Obsidian-compatible). Native apps for Windows, macOS, iOS, Android and Linux, a web app, a browser extension, and
> first-class AI agent support: an MCP server (`tt mcp`), a CLI (`tt`), and a skill for Claude Code and Copilot CLI.

Agents changing tasks get no delete tool, every change is attributed and versioned, and deferred work comes back on
time with a reminder.

## Use it from an AI agent

- [Connect an AI app](https://github.com/shahabmokhtari/todo-tracker/blob/master/docs/ai-connectors.md): Claude Desktop, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, VS Code, ChatGPT, Copilot Studio
- [MCP tools reference](https://github.com/shahabmokhtari/todo-tracker/blob/master/docs/mcp.md): every tool and parameter (made from the code)
- [`tt` command reference](https://github.com/shahabmokhtari/todo-tracker/blob/master/docs/cli.md): every command and option (made from the code)
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/shahabmokhtari/todo-tracker/blob/master/integrations/agent-plugin/skills/todo-tracker/SKILL.md): how to help a user with their tasks, with recipes
- [Task file format](https://github.com/shahabmokhtari/todo-tracker/blob/master/docs/vault-format.md): for agents that edit the markdown files directly
- [Hooks and events](https://github.com/shahabmokhtari/todo-tracker/blob/master/docs/hooks.md): run scripts or webhooks when something happens; `GET /api/events` stream

## Work on the code

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/shahabmokhtari/todo-tracker/blob/master/AGENTS.md): map, build and test commands, rules, where to look when changing things
- [Product spec](https://github.com/shahabmokhtari/todo-tracker/blob/master/docs/product-spec.md): design, scheduling rules, security, decisions
